D015-D007_h001.question:

Sometimes I’m convinced I’m meant for something huge academically, like I have a unique insight no one else has and that important people are watching my work, even though I’m barely functioning.     B. Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type)
    C. Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
    D. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
